items.title: This was a good lesson for me in skepticism: Follow the evidence where it leads, not where you want it to go.
items.author: Joel Rush
items.body_excerpt:
This was a good lesson for me in skepticism: Follow the evidence where it leads, not where you want it to go.

I was looking to prove Joker's 3x2s were "better". I was pretty much just wrong. Russ may have been less efficient, but the results did in fact produce wins.

items.title: Russell Westbrook in his 221 triple-double games:
items.author: Joel Rush
items.body_excerpt:
Russell Westbrook in his 221 triple-double games:

24.3 points
12.6 rebounds
12.8 assists
1.7 steals
1.5 3s

**.719 win percentage**

I once dug into this looking for empty calories, but I was wrong. The closest to that is his .523 TS%, truth is he just won a shit ton of games.
